items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He and I got along very well sonically. I knew exactly what he wanted, and he knew I could get it for him. Everything went swiftly from there after. Wherever he went, I went.

ctx.x: So during, when Bethlehem was another label that did some things for you and that’s when you met Creed Taylor.

Correct. Creed Taylor was running Bethlehem label and he was doing some interesting projects. He and I got along very well sonically. I knew exactly what he wanted, and he knew I could get it for him. Everything went swiftly from there after. Wherever he went, I went. There was a time when he used the studio exclusively.
